sources.text:
Tarvantovaara Wilderness Area (Finnish: Tarvantovaaran erämaa) is a wilderness reserve in Enontekiö municipality, Lapland, Finland. It is governed by Metsähallitus and covers 670 square kilometres (260 mi2). It was established in 1991 like all the other wilderness areas in Lapland.


== See also ==
Wilderness areas of Finland
